fusions.name: Ambush Spring
fusions.desc: A sudden leap that deals 28 damage as a critical hit, up to 1.5 times that at its full 6 tiles. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Spawn Clutch
fusions.desc: Lobs an egg of spawn that hits the first enemy in its path for 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lily Roost
fusions.desc: Raises a lily-pad roost where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 8% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Bug Snatcher
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt deals 6 damage to the next nearest enemy within 4 tiles. Once every 4 seconds.
